findings.title: Sensitive configuration uses a public environment name
findings.description: A sensitive-looking setting has a browser-public naming convention. No active credential or actual browser bundle exposure has been verified.
findings.remediation: Keep privileged credentials in server-only configuration. If exposure is verified, rotate the credential and review its use.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-005 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Destructive agent tool needs permission review
findings.description: A potentially destructive operation appears in an agent tool list. The pattern cannot determine whether approval and authorization are enforced inside the tool.
findings.remediation: Apply authorization inside each tool, restrict its capability, and require explicit approval where the operation warrants it.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-007 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Dynamic code execution needs trust-boundary review
findings.description: A dynamic execution sink was detected. This is a pattern match, not proof of attacker-controlled execution.
findings.remediation: Replace dynamic code execution with explicit operations where possible; otherwise document and enforce the trust boundary.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-003 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Raw SQL execution needs input tracing
findings.description: An unsafe SQL execution API is present. User control of the query and runtime reachability have not been established.
findings.remediation: Prefer parameterized queries. Trace every value reaching this call before deciding whether an injection vulnerability exists.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-001 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Object lookup needs tenant authorization review
findings.description: An object lookup begins with an ID filter. This is a review hotspot, not evidence of a missing authorization check; inspect middleware, service policy, RLS and the complete call path.
findings.remediation: Verify object-level access for the authenticated tenant. Add a regression test using two tenants and reject cross-tenant access.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-004 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: HTML rendering bypass needs sanitization review
findings.description: Raw HTML reaches a React rendering sink. The scanner does not prove that the value is attacker-controlled or unsanitized.
findings.remediation: Establish the source of the HTML and verify an appropriate sanitizer. Prefer rendering text when rich HTML is unnecessary.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-002 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Wildcard cross-origin policy needs context review
findings.description: A wildcard CORS origin was found. Public endpoints may intentionally permit it; authentication and exposed data determine the risk.
findings.remediation: Define expected browser origins and validate the credential model. Do not treat CORS as an authorization mechanism.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-006 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

controls.title: Sensitive mutations authenticate a principal
controls.rationale: No supported sensitive mutation boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped mutating routes and server actions that reach database, raw SQL, command, or file operations. Webhooks are evaluated separately.
controls.verification: Test each boundary without a session/token and confirm rejection before the sensitive operation.
limitations: Gateway, middleware, identity-provider, and database policy outside the bounded map may change the result.

controls.title: Sensitive read routes receive an authentication review
controls.rationale: No missing-authentication candidate was found across 2 mapped sensitive read route(s).
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped Next.js GET and HEAD routes that reach database, raw SQL, command, or file operations.
controls.verification: Test anonymous and wrong-tenant reads. Confirm intentionally public routes expose only approved fields.
limitations: Gateway controls and public-route intent outside the captured source remain unverified.

controls.title: Administrative mutations enforce permission
controls.rationale: No supported admin/internal mutation boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped admin/internal routes and actions that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Test an authenticated non-admin principal against every privileged action.

controls.title: Dynamic resource access is tenant or owner scoped
controls.rationale: 0 of 1 dynamic database boundary(s) contain a recognized tenant, owner, account, organization, or user scope in the captured call arguments.
controls.applicability: Applies when a caller-selectable path parameter reaches a mapped database operation.
controls.verification: Run cross-tenant and wrong-owner identifier tests and inspect effective RLS/database policy.
limitations: Scope passed through an unrecognized object or enforced by RLS may remain unverified.

controls.title: Sensitive entry points validate caller-controlled input
controls.rationale: 0 of 2 sensitive entry point(s) contain a recognized validation call within five explicit call hops.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped routes/actions that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Test malformed, oversized, unexpected-type, and boundary input before the sensitive operation.
limitations: Inline/manual validation and framework coercion may not be recognized.

controls.title: Raw SQL keeps request data out of query structure
controls.rationale: 1 raw SQL input-flow candidate(s) require review.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped request/action code reaches raw SQL execution.
controls.verification: Trace each query fragment, replace structural interpolation with parameters, and test metacharacter payloads without modifying production data.
limitations: Indirect builders, ORM-specific safe tagged templates, and database-side controls may require manual review.

controls.title: Process execution keeps request data out of commands and executable selection
controls.rationale: No supported process execution boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped request/action code can start a local process.
controls.verification: Use fixed executables and argument arrays without a shell, then test separators, option injection, encoding, and unexpected executable names.

controls.title: Filesystem paths remain inside server-owned roots
controls.rationale: No supported filesystem boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped entry points read, write, rename, or delete local files.
controls.verification: Test decoded parent traversal, absolute paths, separators, symlinks, and race conditions against the canonical storage root.

controls.title: Outbound destinations are server-owned or safely constrained
controls.rationale: No supported outbound request boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped entry points can initiate server-side network requests.
controls.verification: Test untrusted public, private, loopback, metadata, DNS-rebinding, and redirect destinations against the effective egress policy.
limitations: Network egress controls and DNS behavior are outside source-only evidence.

controls.title: Redirect destinations are constrained
controls.rationale: No supported redirect boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped entry points construct a redirect response.
controls.verification: Test external, scheme-relative, encoded, mixed-case, and userinfo-form destinations against the effective redirect policy.

controls.title: File uploads enforce size, content, and storage-path constraints
controls.rationale: No decisive upload gap was mapped, but the profiler cannot prove that uploads are absent or fully constrained.
controls.applicability: Applies when an HTTP boundary accepts files or multipart form data.
controls.verification: Test byte limits, file count, MIME/content mismatch, polyglots, generated names, traversal, overwrite, and storage execution policy.
limitations: Streaming parsers and framework upload middleware may not be recognized.

controls.title: Webhook authenticity is verified before processing
controls.rationale: No supported webhook/callback boundary reaching a sensitive operation was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to webhook/callback routes that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Send missing, invalid, replayed, and stale signatures and confirm rejection before parsing or persistence.
limitations: Provider SDK verification with an unrecognized function name may remain unverified.

controls.title: Webhook side effects resist duplicate delivery
controls.rationale: No supported webhook/callback boundary reaching a sensitive operation was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to webhook/callback boundaries whose repeated delivery can persist data or repeat another sensitive effect.
controls.verification: Replay the same provider event concurrently and after a failure; confirm one durable effect and safe retry recovery.
limitations: Database uniqueness, queue deduplication, or provider infrastructure outside the mapped source may enforce replay safety.

controls.title: Abuse-sensitive routes apply rate limits
controls.rationale: No supported abuse-sensitive boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped authentication, account recovery, invitation, verification, checkout, and billing boundaries.
controls.verification: Burst requests by IP and account identifier, then confirm bounded retries, useful backoff, and no easy key rotation bypass.
limitations: Gateway, CDN, identity-provider, or distributed limiter enforcement outside the repository may remain unverified.

controls.title: Billing mutations derive charged values on the server
controls.rationale: No supported billing-provider mutation was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped checkout, payment-intent, subscription, invoice-item, refund, and transaction mutations.
controls.verification: Tamper with plan, price, product, amount, currency, quantity, discount, and tenant ownership; compare the provider-side charge with the server catalog.
limitations: Billing calls reached through another function or package are structurally mapped, but client-value taint is not yet propagated into the dedicated SaaS rule.
Business pricing rules, provider dashboard configuration, discounts, taxes, and webhook reconciliation remain outside source-only proof.

controls.title: Recovery and invitation tokens have a bounded lifecycle
controls.rationale: No supported recovery, invitation, or verification boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to password recovery, invitations, email verification, unlock, magic-link, and OTP-style flows.
controls.verification: Test expiry, replay, concurrent redemption, account binding, user enumeration, token disclosure, and invalidation after password or email changes.
limitations: The mechanical scan cannot prove atomic consumption, delivery-channel security, or identity-provider policy.

controls.title: OAuth/OIDC flows bind redirects and authorization responses
controls.rationale: No supported OAuth/OIDC boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to OAuth/OIDC authorization initiation, callbacks, and account linking.
controls.verification: Test missing/reused state, PKCE mismatch, nonce mismatch, redirect variants, login CSRF, account-link confusion, and authorization-code replay.
limitations: Provider SDK defaults and console-registered redirect URIs are external evidence.

controls.title: Tenant-aware data operations enforce a server-side scope
controls.rationale: No tenant-aware database boundary was established by the captured semantics and source.
controls.applicability: Applies after the profiler observes tenant vocabulary or a configured resource-scope helper at a database operation.
controls.verification: Exercise every operation as two tenants, including list, lookup, update, delete, export, background job, and administrative paths; inspect effective RLS separately.
limitations: Row-level security and policy injected below the five-hop map can make an apparent gap safe.

controls.title: Cookie-authenticated mutations validate request origin or CSRF token
controls.rationale: No mapped sensitive mutation also contained a cookie operation.
controls.applicability: Applies when browsers automatically attach authentication cookies to state-changing HTTP requests.
controls.verification: Send cross-site form, fetch, null-Origin, and sibling-subdomain requests; confirm rejection before the sensitive effect.
limitations: SameSite policy or centralized origin validation outside the mapped source may change applicability.

controls.title: Browser security policies are declared and observed
controls.rationale: No effective runtime response was available to confirm browser policies.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped Next.js applications with browser-facing responses.
controls.verification: Observe representative production responses and verify CSP, frame, MIME, referrer, permissions, and transport policies.
limitations: One URL does not establish policy coverage for every route or deployment layer.

controls.title: Sensitive cookies use explicit protection attributes
controls.rationale: No cookie-based session signal was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when captured source uses cookie-based authentication/session state.
controls.verification: Inspect effective Set-Cookie attributes and test production HTTPS, expiry, logout, fixation, and CSRF behavior.

controls.title: Cross-origin access is intentionally constrained
controls.rationale: No effective cross-origin policy was observed; same-origin-only operation is possible but unverified.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped HTTP API entry points.
controls.verification: Test trusted and untrusted Origin values, credential mode, preflight behavior, and server-side authorization independently.

controls.title: Captured current source has no detected secret exposure candidate
controls.rationale: 1 secret or client/server configuration candidate(s) require review.
controls.applicability: Applies to every captured repository.
controls.verification: Review Git history, CI variables, deployment secrets, rotation, and provider-side secret scanning separately.
limitations: Excluded credential files and Git history are not scanned. No finding does not prove that no secret exists.

controls.title: Resolved dependencies are checked against OSV
controls.rationale: No supported resolved npm/pnpm/Yarn lockfile dependency was available.
controls.applicability: Applies when supported lockfiles provide resolved npm ecosystem versions.
controls.verification: Review advisory freshness, runtime reachability, exploit preconditions, and supported upgrade paths.
limitations: Advisory presence does not establish reachability or exploitability.

controls.title: Approved HTTP response posture is observed
controls.rationale: No target URL was explicitly approved for runtime observation.
controls.applicability: Optional for any authorized running HTTP application.
controls.verification: Probe representative production routes and deployment layers under explicit authorization.
limitations: One bounded HEAD/GET observation is not DAST or whole-application runtime coverage.

controls.title: Sensitive operations emit security-relevant audit events
controls.rationale: 0 of 2 mapped sensitive boundary(s) contain a recognized audit/security logging call.
controls.applicability: Applies to authentication, authorization, administrative, data-changing, and integration-sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Confirm event content, actor, target, outcome, correlation ID, retention, access controls, and alerting in the real logging system.
limitations: Platform telemetry and logging wrappers with unrecognized names are outside source-only evidence.

controls.title: Sensitive boundaries define explicit failure handling
controls.rationale: 0 of 2 mapped sensitive boundary(s) contain an explicit catch clause within five call hops.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped sensitive request/action boundaries.
controls.verification: Exercise dependency, validation, authorization, and storage failures; confirm safe responses and useful internal diagnostics.
limitations: Framework-level error boundaries and centralized handlers may remain unverified.

controls.title: Next.js caching keeps user and tenant data isolated
controls.rationale: No supported user-specific cache isolation candidate was found in the bounded Next.js scan.
controls.applicability: Applies to captured Next.js cache functions and authenticated route responses.
controls.verification: Test two users or tenants against warm cache entries and inspect Cache-Control behavior at the deployed edge.
limitations: Runtime cache keys, CDN configuration, and reverse-proxy behavior remain outside source-only proof.

controls.title: Next.js client boundaries exclude privileged configuration and response data
controls.rationale: No supported privileged public environment or sensitive server response field candidate was found.
controls.applicability: Applies to NEXT_PUBLIC variables and captured Next.js server response objects.
controls.verification: Inspect production client bundles, RSC payloads, and API responses for privileged values.

controls.title: Dynamic HTML preserves React output encoding
controls.rationale: No unsanitized dynamic dangerouslySetInnerHTML candidate was found in the bounded React scan.
controls.applicability: Applies to captured runtime JSX and TSX modules.
controls.verification: Test script, event-handler, URL, SVG, malformed markup, and mutation-XSS payloads at every intentional HTML rendering boundary.
limitations: Sanitizer policy configuration and browser mutation behavior require runtime review.

controls.title: Client navigation, storage, and messaging use constrained browser boundaries
controls.rationale: No supported unsafe client URL, Web Storage, postMessage, or new-tab pattern was found.
controls.applicability: Applies to explicit Client Component modules.
controls.verification: Exercise untrusted URLs, message origins, storage access after script injection, and external new-tab navigation.

controls.title: Server and Client Component boundaries keep privileged data on the server
controls.rationale: No supported server-only import, sensitive prop, async Client Component, or private environment boundary candidate was found.
controls.applicability: Applies to Next.js applications using React Server and Client Components.
controls.verification: Inspect serialized RSC payloads and production client bundles for credentials, privileged session objects, and server-only modules.
